blocks.text: SCHEDULE: Gilas Pilipinas at Fiba Asian Qualifiers Window 5 The height advantage Gilas Pilipinas flaunted entering the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers was on full display in Friday’s blowout of Syria in Seremban, Malaysia. Bennie Boatwright, Kai Sotto, Mike Phillips, AJ Edu and Quentin Millora-Brown shared the duties in making sure Gilas would assert itself down low in the 97-58 victory at Karisma Arena. “Our size kind of took over the game at some point,” Cone said.
